sources.title: Hierarchical Clustering for Finding Symmetries and Other Patterns in Massive, High Dimensional Datasets
sources.enterprise_use: Documents the mature connection between hierarchical structure and ultrametric topology. P018 Supplement 14 therefore does not claim that merge hierarchies inducing ultrametric structure is new; it studies the exact deterministic finite-time realization supplied by Enterprise Math kernel/stabilization dynamics.
sources.not_claimed: Hierarchical clustering, dendrograms, and their ultrametric interpretation are established prior mathematics and data-analysis structure.

sources.title: Exchangeable coalescents, ultrametric spaces, nested interval-partitions: A unifying approach
sources.enterprise_use: Provides explicit prior art that coalescent structure and ultrametric spaces are deeply linked. Enterprise Math uses a deterministic finite-state specialization tied to P010/P020 rather than claiming the general coalescent-ultrametric connection.
sources.not_claimed: The general relationship between coalescent processes, nested partitions, trees, and ultrametric spaces is established prior mathematics.
